text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported it at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after the badge scan.

For the whole outage, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. That's the only guard activity in the channel until 11:03 AM. Mateo then reported kiosk 1 back, and the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes working as of 11:07.

Mateo's 10:44 message said six trucks were waiting at the east gate. Nothing in the channel says what else the guard did during the outage.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text:
Ruth, the screenshot is on ticket INC-4821. I posted that answer in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Gideon's 11:08 AM message on 3 Aug says he attached the status-page screenshot to that ticket. His message doesn't name Mateo. I linked it to Mateo's problem because Mateo reported "access denied" on the status page at 10:44, and Gideon was still chasing the status-page access issue.
